facts: Schoharie 溪橋 1954 年通車，1987 年 4 月 5 日因三號墩基礎沖刷崩塌，10 人罹難

factsEn: The Schoharie Creek Bridge opened in 1954 and collapsed on 5 April 1987 when pier 3 was undermined by scour, killing 10 people
The old Kaoping Bridge, completed in 1978, lost piers P22 and P23 on 27 August 2000; 17 vehicles fell and 22 people were injured
The Houfeng Bridge fell during Typhoon Sinlaku on 14 September 2008; investigators linked it to a hydraulic jump from a bed drop of about 4 to 5 m
The rebuilt Houfeng Bridge fully opened on 29 June 2010, widened from 31 m to 41 m
NCHRP Report 396: the magnetic sliding collar achieved about ±0.15 m accuracy at 0.3 m magnet spacing against a ±0.3 m target

HEC-18 5th edition (FHWA-HIF-12-003) was published in April 2012
HEC-18 cites a 1973 study of 383 flood-damaged bridges: 25% involved pier damage and 75% abutment damage

procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條傳力路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出跨度或高度、結構系統、主要荷載與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which load path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in span or height, structural system, main loads and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.title: 傳力、算例與驗證：橋梁基礎沖刷監測
guides.titleEn: Load paths, calculations and verification: Bridge-foundation scour monitoring
guides.concept: 從長期河床降低、束縮沖刷與橋墩局部沖刷三個分量出發，以 HEC-18 公式估算沖刷深度並評估擴展基礎與樁基的暴露後果，再處理拋石保護、聲納與磁性滑環等固定式監測儀的安裝、施工期河道束縮、即時警戒值、振動頻率識別、行動計畫與洪後檢查，並以 1987 年紐約 Schoharie 溪橋、2000 年高屏大橋與 2008 年后豐大橋的斷橋為鑑。
guides.conceptEn: Starting from the three components of long-term degradation, contraction scour and local pier scour, estimate scour depth with the HEC-18 equation and assess the consequences of exposure for spread footings and piles, then cover riprap protection, installation of fixed monitors such as sonar and magnetic sliding collars, construction-stage channel contraction, real-time alarm levels, vibration-based detection, plans of action and post-flood inspection, learning from the bridge failures of Schoharie Creek in New York (1987), Kaoping (2000) and Houfeng (2008).
procedure: 洪水對橋梁的威脅多半不是水流把橋推倒，而是把基礎下方的土砂帶走：長期河床降低來自上游攔砂、河道整治或採砂造成的輸砂失衡；束縮沖刷發生在橋孔縮窄、流速升高的斷面；局部沖刷則是水流撞到墩柱時，向下的潛流與墩前馬蹄形渦流把墩旁床料掏空。三者疊加後，若沖刷面低於擴展基礎底或使樁失去足夠的側向支撐，橋墩就會沉陷、傾斜或倒塌。台灣河川坡陡、颱風洪峰短而急，三個分量都可能在一次洪水中同時發展。
局部沖刷深度主要取決於墩寬、上游水深與流速（以福祿數表示）、墩頭形狀、墩軸與水流的夾角以及床況。美國聯邦公路總署 HEC-18（第 5 版，2012 年）採用的 CSU 公式以這些參數的冪次關係表示沖刷深度與墩寬之比，屬於保守的包絡估計。其中最容易被低估的是夾角：長形墩斜交水流時，有效擋水寬度大增，沖刷深度可增加五成以上；颱風洪水夾帶的漂流木堆積在墩前，也等於加寬了墩體。
沖刷對不同基礎的後果不同：擴展基礎一旦底下的土被掏空，承載面積驟減，基礎會傾斜或突然下陷，幾乎沒有預警；沉箱與樁基則在沖刷後失去上段土壤的側向支撐，自由長度變長，水平勁度、彎矩容量與挫屈能力都下降，且承受的流水壓力與漂流物撞擊力增加。1987 年紐約州高速公路 Schoharie 溪橋就是三號墩擴展基礎被淘空掉入沖刷坑而崩塌，造成 10 人死亡；調查也指出拋石過輕且保護、檢查與維護不足。
沖刷保護分為水理與結構兩類：拋石、混凝土塊、蛇籠或袋裝混凝土在墩周形成抗沖護坦，下方需要濾層或土工織物防止細料被吸出；河床保護工（固床工、潛壩）則穩定整段河床、防止長期降低。拋石大小取決於局部流速的平方，墩前流速受加速影響必須放大；保護範圍要涵蓋墩寬的數倍，否則沖刷坑會從護坦邊緣向內侵蝕。固床工若在下游形成落差，又可能在其下方引發新的沖刷，后豐大橋的水躍即是例證。

固定式監測儀在洪水期間持續量測墩旁河床高程：聲納裝在墩身水面下向下發射聲波量測水深；磁性滑環套在打入河床的導管上，河床下降時滑環隨之下滑並觸發磁性開關；浮出式感測器預先埋在不同深度，被沖出時發出訊號；傾斜計與加速度計則量測墩體的反應。美國 NCHRP 第 396 號報告（1997 年）在多州實地測試這些儀器，磁性滑環以 0.3 m 磁鐵間距可達約 ±0.15 m 精度。選擇儀器要考慮河床材料、漂流物、流速、維護可及性與資料傳輸。
新建或改建橋梁時，圍堰、施工便橋、工作平台與堆置的土方都會佔用河道，使通水寬度縮窄、流速升高，在汛期造成比完工後更嚴重的束縮沖刷，危及既有橋墩與尚未完成的新基礎。施工計畫因此要以汛期洪水檢核臨時工程，必要時在汛期前撤除或降低圍堰。河道上的採砂也會使床面長期下降；高屏大橋所在河段在 1995 年就已撤除採砂船，顯示採砂對橋基的長期影響早受關注。
聲納以聲波往返時間換算到河床的距離，原理簡單，但洪水時的實際困難很多：水中夾帶大量氣泡或高濃度泥沙會吸收與散射聲波，造成訊號遺失；漂流物經過會產生假的淺值；長期浸水的換能器會被生物附著。NCHRP 第 396 號報告的實地測試就記錄到高含氣水流時訊號遺失、佛羅里達潮汐橋墩第二年出現藤壺附著影響讀值。因此即時資料必須經過濾波與合理性檢查，並以多儀器、多指標共同判斷，而不是單一讀值觸發封橋。
直接量測河床的儀器容易在洪水中失效，因此也可以量測橋墩本身的反應：基礎周圍土壤被沖走後，墩—基礎系統的側向勁度降低，自然頻率隨之下降；擴展基礎或淺基礎局部被淘空時，墩體會出現傾斜或沉陷。加速度計與傾斜計裝在水面以上，不受洪水直接破壞，維護也較容易。但頻率同時受溫度、水位附加質量與上部結構影響，必須先建立正常狀態的基準與變化範圍，才能從中辨識沖刷造成的偏移。

監測只是工具，真正保護用路人的是事先寫好的行動計畫：美國聯邦法規要求每座被列為沖刷危急的橋梁都必須有行動計畫，內容包括檢查與監測的方式和頻率、封橋與重新開放的條件、繞道路線、責任人與聯絡方式，以及設計和施作永久保護工的時程。HEC-23 第 3 版（2009 年）也強調，監測本身不能讓橋梁脫離沖刷危急的分類，只能爭取時間或在特定情況下作為對策。台灣的公路主管機關也採用分級預警封橋，例如 2026 年 6 月公告台 9 線萬里溪橋將隨上游堰塞湖警戒層級提升辦理預警性封閉。
洪峰時沖刷坑最深，退水期間上游來砂又會回填沖刷坑，因此洪後測深看到的河床可能比洪峰時高出許多，回填的鬆散砂土也沒有原土的承載與側向支撐能力。只依洪後測量判斷，會低估基礎曾經暴露的程度。洪後檢查要結合監測紀錄的最低河床、潛水或水下聲納掃描、基礎外觀與墩體傾斜量測，並把結果寫入每座橋的沖刷歷史，作為下一次行動計畫與保護工設計的依據。
procedureEn: A flood rarely threatens a bridge by pushing it over; it removes the soil beneath the foundations. Long-term degradation comes from sediment imbalance caused by upstream dams, channel works or mining; contraction scour occurs where the waterway narrows and velocity rises; local scour occurs as flow strikes a pier, where downflow and the horseshoe vortex at the nose excavate the bed beside it. When the three add up so that the scoured bed falls below a spread footing or piles lose enough lateral support, the pier settles, tilts or collapses. Taiwan's steep rivers and short, intense typhoon floods can develop all three components in a single event.

Local scour depth depends mainly on pier width, approach depth and velocity (expressed as Froude number), nose shape, the angle between pier and flow and bed condition. The CSU equation adopted in the U.S. Federal Highway Administration's HEC-18 (5th edition, 2012) expresses scour depth over pier width as a power function of these parameters and is a conservative envelope. The most easily underestimated factor is skew: an elongated pier at an angle to the flow presents a much wider obstruction, raising scour depth by 50% or more; debris rafts lodged against a pier in a typhoon flood also effectively widen it.

Scour affects foundation types differently. Once soil beneath a spread footing is removed, the bearing area shrinks abruptly and the footing tilts or drops suddenly with almost no warning; caissons and piles lose lateral support from the upper soil, so their free length increases and lateral stiffness, moment capacity and buckling resistance fall while flow pressure and debris impact grow. The 1987 Schoharie Creek Bridge collapse on the New York State Thruway began when pier 3, on an undermined spread footing, dropped into a scour hole, killing 10 people; investigators also found the riprap too light and protection, inspection and maintenance inadequate.

Countermeasures are hydraulic or structural: riprap, concrete blocks, gabions or grout bags form an erosion-resistant apron around the pier, with a filter layer or geotextile beneath to stop fines being drawn out; bed-protection works such as check dams stabilise a reach and stop long-term degradation. Riprap size depends on the square of local velocity, which must be amplified for acceleration around the pier; the apron must extend several pier widths, or the scour hole eats inward from its edge. A bed-protection structure that creates a drop can trigger new scour below it, as the hydraulic jump at the Houfeng Bridge showed.

Fixed instruments measure the bed elevation beside a pier continuously during a flood: a sonar mounted on the pier below water sends acoustic pulses down to measure depth; a magnetic sliding collar rides on a pipe driven into the bed and slides down as the bed drops, tripping magnetic switches; float-out sensors buried at several depths signal when they are washed out; tilt meters and accelerometers measure pier response. NCHRP Report 396 (1997) field-tested such instruments in several states, with the magnetic sliding collar reaching about ±0.15 m accuracy at 0.3 m magnet spacing. Selection must consider bed material, debris, velocity, maintenance access and data transmission.

During construction or replacement, cofferdams, temporary trestles, work platforms and stockpiles occupy the channel, narrowing the waterway and raising velocity, so in the flood season contraction scour can be worse than after completion, endangering existing piers and unfinished new foundations. The construction plan must therefore check temporary works against flood-season discharges, removing or lowering cofferdams before the season where needed. Mining in the channel also lowers the bed over time; on the reach of the Kaoping Bridge, sand-dredging boats had already been removed in 1995, showing how long mining's effect on foundations has been a concern.

Sonar converts the round-trip time of an acoustic pulse into distance to the bed. The principle is simple, but floods bring many practical problems: heavy air entrainment or high sediment concentration absorbs and scatters sound and causes signal loss, passing debris produces false shallow readings, and transducers submerged for long periods foul with marine growth. Field tests in NCHRP Report 396 recorded signal loss in highly air-entrained flow and barnacle growth affecting a Florida tidal pier unit in its second year. Real-time data must therefore be filtered and sanity-checked, and decisions made from several instruments and indicators rather than a single reading triggering closure.

Instruments that measure the bed directly tend to fail in floods, so engineers can measure the pier's own response instead: once soil around the foundation is removed, the lateral stiffness of the pier–foundation system falls and its natural frequency drops; when a spread or shallow footing is partly undermined, the pier tilts or settles. Accelerometers and tilt meters sit above water, out of direct reach of the flood, and are easier to maintain. Frequency, however, also varies with temperature, added water mass and the superstructure, so a baseline and normal range must be established before a scour-induced shift can be recognised.

Monitoring is only a tool; what protects road users is a plan of action written in advance. U.S. federal regulations require every bridge coded scour-critical to have one, covering inspection and monitoring type and frequency, closure and reopening criteria, detour routes, responsible staff and contacts, and the schedule for designing and building permanent countermeasures. HEC-23 (3rd edition, 2009) stresses that monitoring alone does not remove a bridge from the scour-critical category; it buys time or serves as a countermeasure in specific cases. Taiwan's highway authority also uses tiered pre-emptive closure, for example announcing in June 2026 that the Route 9 Wanli Creek Bridge would be closed as the alert level of an upstream barrier lake rises.

Scour holes are deepest at the flood peak, and on the falling limb incoming sediment refills them, so a post-flood sounding can show the bed much higher than at the peak, and the loose refill lacks the bearing and lateral support of the original soil. Judging only from post-flood surveys underestimates how far the foundation was exposed. Post-flood inspection must combine the minimum bed elevation from monitoring records, diver or underwater sonar scans, foundation condition and pier tilt measurements, and enter the results into each bridge's scour history as the basis for the next plan of action and countermeasure design.
evidence: 沖刷評估報告要把三個分量分別列出並附上依據，標示每座橋墩的基礎底高程、臨界沖刷高程與目前河床高程；上下游的河床落差、攔河構造物與採砂紀錄須一併納入。
河中墩優先採用圓形或圓頭斷面以降低對流向的敏感度，墩軸對齊洪水主流而非低水流向；設計報告列出不同夾角下的沖刷深度敏感度，並說明漂流木的處理假設。
沖刷危急橋梁的評估要同時算出擴展基礎的臨界沖刷高程與樁基在暴露狀態下的承載與穩定，並把結果寫成可供現場使用的「臨界河床高程」表；未知基礎的舊橋暫以保守假設列為高風險。
保護工設計要附上石塊尺寸、級配、厚度、濾層、平面範圍與預期壽命，並把洪後補充列入維護計畫；採用固床工時，同步評估下游落差可能引起的沖刷，並與水利主管機關協調。
監測位置以沖刷計算最深、基礎最淺的墩與墩頭為優先，至少兩種原理不同的儀器互相備援；纜線走在墩身凹槽或保護管內，設計時就預留維修通道與枯水期更換程序。
evidenceEn: The scour evaluation report lists the three components separately with their basis and marks, for each pier, foundation base elevation, critical scour elevation and current bed elevation; upstream and downstream bed drops, weirs and mining records are included.

Prefer circular or round-nosed piers in the river to reduce sensitivity to flow direction, align them with flood flow rather than low flow, and list scour sensitivity to skew angle and the debris assumptions in the design report.

Assessments of scour-critical bridges compute the critical scour elevation for spread footings and the capacity and stability of exposed piles, writing the results as a critical bed-elevation table usable in the field; old bridges with unknown foundations are treated conservatively as high risk.

Countermeasure design states stone size, gradation, thickness, filter, plan extent and expected life, with post-flood replenishment in the maintenance plan; when using bed-protection structures, assess scour from any downstream drop and coordinate with the water-resources authority.

Prioritise piers and pier noses with the deepest computed scour and shallowest foundations, using at least two instruments of different principle as backup; route cables in pier recesses or protective conduits, and provide maintenance access and a dry-season replacement procedure from design.
pitfalls: 2008 年 9 月 14 日辛樂克颱風期間，台中大甲溪上的后豐大橋斷落，調查認為河床落差與埋管造成約 4 至 5 m 的落差引發水躍，持續沖刷橋墩使基樁裸露；只計算局部沖刷而忽略河床落差與長期降低，會嚴重低估基礎暴露。
擴展基礎淘空時，橋墩可能在洪峰中毫無徵兆地沉陷，Schoharie 溪橋的上部結構隨墩下落，後續又因殘骸阻塞河道使相鄰墩流速升高；樁基裸露過長則在水流與漂流木撞擊下彎曲破壞或整體傾斜。
感測器只裝在一座墩或裝在墩的下游側，最深的沖刷坑發生在未監測的上游墩頭，警報沒有觸發；纜線沿墩身外露，第一場颱風就被漂流木扯斷，系統在最需要時沒有資料。
未過濾的聲納資料在洪峰時因氣泡頻繁跳到極淺或極深，值班人員對誤報麻木而忽略真警報；或系統在訊號遺失時沿用最後一筆正常值，洪峰期間顯示「穩定」，實際河床正在快速下降。
2000 年 8 月 27 日碧利斯颱風後，高屏大橋 P22、P23 橋墩被洪水沖毀，17 輛車墜落、22 人受傷；沒有可執行的封橋門檻與即時資訊時，車輛仍在洪峰期間通行，基礎破壞直接變成人員傷亡。
pitfallsEn: During Typhoon Sinlaku on 14 September 2008, the Houfeng Bridge over the Dajia River in Taichung collapsed; investigators considered that a bed drop of about 4 to 5 m associated with a buried water pipe created a hydraulic jump that kept scouring the pier and exposed the piles. Computing only local scour while ignoring bed drops and long-term degradation badly underestimates foundation exposure.

An undermined spread footing can drop without warning at the flood peak; at Schoharie Creek the superstructure fell with the pier, and wreckage partly blocking the river may have raised velocities at the adjacent pier. Overexposed piles bend to failure or tilt as a group under flow and debris impact.

Sensors on only one pier, or on the downstream face, miss the deepest scour at an unmonitored upstream nose, so no alarm is raised; cables run exposed down the pier are torn off by debris in the first typhoon, leaving no data when it matters most.

Unfiltered sonar data jumping to very shallow or very deep values in aerated flow make duty staff numb to false alarms so they ignore a real one; or a system that holds the last good value during signal loss shows stable readings through the peak while the bed is actually dropping fast.

After Typhoon Bilis, on 27 August 2000, floodwater washed out piers P22 and P23 of the Kaoping Bridge, dropping 17 vehicles and injuring 22 people; without enforceable closure thresholds and real-time information, traffic keeps crossing at the flood peak and foundation failure turns directly into casualties.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 橋梁健康監測感測網
related.transfer: 可遷移「沖刷分量與洪水荷載路徑」與「即時監測資料與警戒判斷」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；橋梁健康監測感測網的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Scour components and the flood load path" and "Real-time monitoring data and alarm decisions" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Structural health-monitoring networks for bridges must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以沖刷深度估算、基礎暴露評估、固定式感測器與行動計畫，在洪峰期間判斷何時封橋；橋梁健康監測感測網則以從監測問題反推感測器種類、位置、取樣與同步，並把資料變成可行動的警戒與維護決策為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on scour-depth estimation, foundation-exposure assessment, fixed sensors and plans of action that decide when to close a bridge during a flood peak; Structural health-monitoring networks for bridges centres on working back from monitoring questions to sensor types, locations, sampling and synchronisation, and turning data into actionable alerts and maintenance decisions, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「總沖刷深度三分量」與「監測目標清單」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到橋梁健康監測感測網，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「模態識別與環境效應分離」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Three components of total scour” and “Monitoring objectives list”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Structural health-monitoring networks for bridges, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Modal identification and environmental effects", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 橋梁基礎沖刷監測
history.text: 1987 年 4 月 5 日紐約州高速公路 Schoharie 溪橋因三號墩擴展基礎被淘空而崩塌，造成 10 人死亡，促使美國全面檢討橋梁沖刷的設計、檢查與維護；聯邦公路總署陸續發布 HEC-18 沖刷評估與 HEC-23 保護工指引，NCHRP 第 396 號報告（1997 年）則在多州實地測試聲納、磁性滑環與浮出式等監測儀器。台灣方面，2000 年碧利斯颱風後高屏大橋 P22、P23 橋墩被沖毀，2008 年辛樂克颱風造成大甲溪后豐大橋斷落，使沖刷監測、預警封橋與河川採砂管理成為公路養護的重點。現行 HEC-18 為 2012 年第 5 版，HEC-23 為 2009 年第 3 版。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或監測文件。
history.textEn: On 5 April 1987 the Schoharie Creek Bridge on the New York State Thruway collapsed when the spread footing of pier 3 was undermined, killing 10 people and prompting a nationwide review of scour design, inspection and maintenance in the United States; the Federal Highway Administration went on to publish HEC-18 for scour evaluation and HEC-23 for countermeasures, and NCHRP Report 396 (1997) field-tested sonar, magnetic sliding collar and float-out monitors in several states. In Taiwan, piers P22 and P23 of the Kaoping Bridge were washed out after Typhoon Bilis in 2000, and Typhoon Sinlaku brought down the Houfeng Bridge over the Dajia River in 2008, making scour monitoring, pre-emptive closure and control of river mining priorities for highway maintenance. The current HEC-18 is the 5th edition of 2012 and HEC-23 the 3rd edition of 2009. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or monitoring documents.
